in_marathi.name: Hitesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hitesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Hitesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'hīt', meaning sun, and 'īsh', meaning god. The name signifies the sun god and is considered an auspicious and powerful name in Hindu culture.
